description:
Key contributor to the team building the Formulation Center platform, an AI-powered cloud-native software used daily by 8,000+ researchers worldwide.
Led design & delivery of raw materials domain APIs and web apps.
Architected platform engineering stack (microservices & front-end templates, React design system, .NET libraries, Helm) -> powering 100+ apps.
Kubernetes & Azure administrator — designed CI/CD workflows, maintained operators, led infra upgrades.
Created PowerBI dashboards → enabled ExCom to make data-driven strategic decisions
Recruited & mentored developers, led code reviews & workshops.

Contributed to the operation of 400+ localized websites across all brands with 99.99% SLA.
Built a mass-import tool (.NET) -> reduced KPI dashboard refresh time from 12h to 30min.
Prototyped Virtual Reality experiences to enhance consumer interaction.
Designed monitoring dashboards for Ops team, reducing incident resolution time.
